|game_text=Deploy on table. Womp Rats are not [Selective Creature]. Once per turn, may deploy a creature (except a parasite) or a dewback from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. |errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Krayt Dragon Bones (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on table. Womp Rats are not [Selective Creature]. Once per turn, may ▼ a creature (except a parasite) or a dewback. Your ferocious creatures are deploy -2 and ferocity +1. Whenever you retrieve Force because a creature has eaten a card, you need only use X-2 Force for Aim High (to a minimum of 1). (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the release-sheet wording again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Krayt Dragon Bones (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Krayt Dragon Bones (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spelled “because a creature has eaten” as “because a creatue has eaten” (typo kept as published). PC-E1 text: “Deploy on table. Womp Rats are not [Selective Creature]. Once per turn, may deploy a creature (except a parasite) or a dewback from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your ferocious creatures are deploy -2 and ferocity +1. Whenever you retrieve Force because a creatue has eaten a card, you need only use X-2 Force for Aim High (to a minimum of 1). (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1240_29">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card-list entry ends with the Players Committee's own label “(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”, the date of the errata that the “E” slip also shows; the wording of the entry differs from the slip as described.
